doc.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

chapter: Georgette's memories of the Basie band
title: Riding Basie's trains and band nicknames
summary: Georgette recalls children and wives at breakfast on the train, band nicknames, and Sweets and the strawberry ice cream.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: There’s a story I remember traveling with Basie and at that time they traveled on the trains and this is when they had the berth that you could sleep in. And then you’d have, every morning the wives with the kids of all the musicians would come and we’d come to breakfast. And there was Snooky, played the trumpet with Basie at the time, and then Earle Warren, and I’d have names for all of them. Well musicians have names for each other, Smiley, and Sweets —

They all had names for each other. But now I knew they all had names so I started naming them. And I used to call Earle Warren “Egghead” and Sweets, he always would take me to get strawberry ice cream, but I always bothered him. He said, “you always bug © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-
— there’s your father, go ask your father.” And I said, “no I want you to get me the strawberry ice cream.” Because he had all this money.

He would be asleep, and I would be asleep, and she wouldn’t. See we’d be on the train and she’d wake him up and so he says, “tell your father to go get it for you, Georgia,” he says, “I don’t want to.”
